evals.prompt: Add CI for this Node repo: lint, typecheck, test, build.
evals.expected_output: Creates .github/workflows/ci.yml with a kebab-case id, default-deny top-level permissions, SHA-pinned checkout/setup-node, a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress, timeout-minutes on the job, lockfile-keyed npm cache, and lint/typecheck/test/build steps. Uses the minimal scale tier (rung 1).

evals.prompt: Set up a deploy workflow to production with OIDC to AWS.
evals.expected_output: Creates a deploy workflow with permissions id-token: write, a SHA-pinned aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials using a role ARN, an environment: production, a fixed semantic deploy concurrency group (no cancel), timeout-minutes, and no long-lived AWS keys.
